fields.label: Dataset ID
fields.help: The ID of the dataset containing this row access policy.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Filter Predicate
fields.help: A SQL boolean expression that represents the rows defined by this row access policy, similar to the boolean expression in a WHERE clause of a SELECT query on a table.

fields.label: Policy ID
fields.help: The ID of the row access policy.

fields.label: Table ID
fields.help: The ID of the table containing this row access policy.
